description: Refurbishment of existing signs comprising of 1no externally illuminated (bullet illumination) double sided projecting (pictorial) sign, 1no externally illuminated fascia lettering sign and 1no history board wall mounted sign at the front elevation; external refurbishment to include: refurbishment and polishing of 2no six sided lanterns and 5no brass cowl lights.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

Drawings pack titled "The Salutation, Hammersmith" prepared by Omega Signs Limited Issue 2 - 31-07-26. 

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials (including colour and finish) specified on the drawings hereby approved. The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. All disturbed surfaces shall be made good using materials to match the existing materials, composition, form, finish and colour of the existing building. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The illumination of the [sign(s)]/advertisement(s)] shall comply with the 
recommendations of the Institution of Lighting Professionals in the 'Guidance Note 
01/20: Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light'. and the 'Professional 
Lighting Guide No 5, 2023 - Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements'.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not 
adversely affected by artificial lighting, in accordance with Policies CC12 and CC13 of he Local Plan 2018.
